parsed.rationale: Analytics dashboard load time increased from under 5 seconds to 30–45 seconds after the last release; the issue is ongoing and impacting users, indicating a post-release performance regression.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi team—thanks for the details. You’re seeing a clear post-release performance regression: the analytics dashboard that previously loaded in under 5 seconds is now taking ~30–45 seconds to load for your operations team, which is impacting daily planning.

To help us narrow this down quickly, could you share a few specifics?
1) The exact release version/build (or deploy date/time) that correlates with the change.
2) Whether the slowdown is consistent for all operations users/sessions, or only specific users/accounts.
3) What the “30–45 seconds” measurement refers to (e.g., time from clicking the dashboard link until the page is usable), and which browser/page URL.
4) Any recent warnings/errors from the same period (even if there’s no failure), plus any correlation with backend logs (API response times, database/query latency, etc.).
5) Is the delay mostly during initial page load, data retrieval, or rendering (for example, does a loading spinner remain visible for most of the time)?

Once we have the above, we can validate the performance change against the release and identify what component is contributing to the added time. If you’d like, we can also align on a specific test user/session to reproduce the slowdown during our investigation.

In the meantime, if there’s a workaround that helps your team meet planning timelines (e.g., using an alternate dashboard view), feel free to share what you’ve tried—we’ll factor that into the investigation.
promised_actions: Escalate for investigation of the post-release dashboard performance regression.
Request the minimum additional details needed to reproduce/measure the slowdown and correlate it with the release.
safety_notes: Do not claim root cause, fix, or ETA/SLA.
Do not promise a refund or formal resolution; keep actions limited to investigation support and data gathering.
